title: AI Token Demand Monitor, as of Thu 12 Nov 2026 (Europe/Zurich)
bottom_line: View: complete-week OpenRouter volume made a new high in the week of 2 Nov (209.5T tokens, +8.2% WoW, d). Trailing 7-day tokens to 11 Nov were 207.0T, only +1.2% versus the non-overlapping 7 days to 3 Nov, and paid tokens were slightly lower (193.6T, −0.9%, d). CoreWeave reported a $132.5bn revenue backlog at 30 Sep (V, company IR, 10 Nov). View: token volume still supports the capex trajectory; financing terms, not demand, remain the binding transmission risk.

OpenRouter spend has been unpublished since the 7 days to 10 Oct. Portkey and Ramp comparisons are unchanged (not refreshed on 12 Nov): Portkey tokens +15.3% vs cost +4.4% (week of 1 Nov); Ramp Tokenomics volume +37.1% vs spend +8.9% (week to 23 Oct vs 25 Sep).

crack_watch.text: Anthropic compute/revenue 58% in Q3 vs 48% in Q2 (d, S-1/A filed 2 Nov). Contrary: Portkey cost +18.5% since week of 27 Sep, tokens +81.4% (d); not refreshed on 12 Nov.

crack_watch.title: Financing and power
crack_watch.text: CoreWeave backlog $132.5bn at 30 Sep (V, IR 10 Nov) versus $104bn in June (U, CNBC), +27.4% (d; 132.5/104 − 1). 2026 capex guide $37–39bn (V, same IR). CFO: no new parent-level unsecured debt at current yields through 2027 (U, CNBC). Anthropic is buying 1.7 GW of gas generators for $3.4bn (U, Fortune citing the FT; FT not fetched).

This edition's bottom line on financing/credit uses the CoreWeave IR figures above, CNBC (U) for the June comparison and CFO comments, and the token series in this feed. Broker forecasts and terminal credit prints are excluded from this public page (see excluded). The bottom line is a view.

Charts in section 3 are Chart.js redraws of the 8 Nov 2026 pack from public OpenRouter, Ramp, Vercel and Portkey series. Those pack-chart captions were not redrawn for this mid-week feed update. Hyperliquid and prediction-market blocks were not refreshed on 12 Nov and keep their own as_of (11 Nov).

Hyperliquid figures are public HIP-3 perpetual marks from the official info API, not equity or IPO prices. Contract units and oracles differ by deployer (official docs). Implied fully diluted valuation is derived only where the official contract defines a price of $1 as $1 billion of fully diluted valuation. 24-hour change is versus the API previous-day reference, not an official equity close. Annualised funding is a simple 24×365 scaling of the hourly rate and is not a forecast. Some builder-deployed markets are thin. Not investment advice.

Prediction-market yes-probabilities are API-read contract prices from Polymarket and Kalshi, not forecasts. Resolution rules can differ from headlines. Thin markets are flagged. Not investment advice.

notes: Prices are cash-settled HIP-3 perpetual marks, not equity, IPO allocations or claims on the issuer.
Implied fully diluted valuation is derived only for Entropy io: markets, where official docs state that a price of $1 represents $1 billion of fully diluted valuation.
xyz:ANT and para:ANTH are official per-share (expected share price) contracts; no implied valuation is derived for them.
24h change is markPx / prevDayPx - 1, against the API previous-day reference, not an official equity close.
Funding from the API is an hourly rate; annualisation is funding × 24 × 365 and is not a forecast.
Open-interest notional is openInterest × markPx (one side).
Ventuals vntl:OPENAI and vntl:ANTHROPIC are delisted (API isDelisted). They are not live quotes.
Spot tickers ANT (ANT POWER) and OPENAI are not issuer equity markets and are not shown as quotes.
